findings.concern: The current impact JSON identifies touched functions but not the exact diff/range or changed-line input used to derive them.
findings.resolution: An implementation must add a versioned impact provenance block, including the explicit mode (range or files), canonical changed-file/line map, and refusal-safe scope identity.

findings.concern: A bounded closure includes MAY_ENUMERATED edges and may not be rendered as definite reachability.
findings.resolution: Normalized rows retain resolved_cone=possible_bounded and the exact edge-kind vocabulary; comparison status is descriptive and never a gate verdict.

findings.concern: MAY_TOP has no enumerable forward target set.
findings.resolution: Only current observed frontier holders are compared. No inferred hidden-target or forward-completeness delta is emitted.

findings.concern: An invocation digest changes when its DB path changes.
findings.resolution: As in Stage8, preserve it as provenance but compare stable producer identity and an explicit user-supplied scope manifest.

open: Implementation needs its own Roster task and authentic impact fixtures; this design intake writes no product code.
